'''Ayalayli Thornwood''' was a sturdy type of [[Wood/Legends|wood]]. The gong that [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] used during the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] was made of Ayalayli Thornwood.
